dedupe_keys.name: cisa marine transportation system resilience assessment resource matrix rarm

description: The Resilience Assessment Resource Matrix (RARM) is a searchable online library from the US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) that helps users of its Marine Transportation System (MTS) resilience guide carry out resilience assessments of ports and waterways. CISA co-developed it with the US Army Corps of Engineers Engineer Research and Development Center under a memorandum of agreement. Resources are organised by scope (single port, network of ports, inland waterway), tier (basic, mid-level, detailed) and objective (define functions, identify dependencies, understand disruptive events, identify enhancement alternatives). The page read listed 94 resources of several types, tools, data sources, methodologies, guidebooks and funding opportunities, among them the ADCIRC storm surge model and its surge guidance system, NOAA Atlas 14 rainfall, an AIS analysis package (restricted), Bayesian network analysis, the CDC Social Vulnerability Index, the Channel Portfolio Tool (restricted) and the CISA Gateway (restricted). Coverage: the US marine transportation system. Format and access: a public web matrix; each entry notes public or restricted access. Licence and cost: free to browse; restricted entries need government access. Caveats: a directory of other resources, not data in itself. It helps plan resilience, hazard exposure and dependency studies of ports and waterways. It lists the CDC Social Vulnerability Index and relates to the World Port Index in the catalogue.
